name: Squat
cues: Feet shoulder-width apart, toes slightly out
Hip crease below knee at bottom position

rules.feedback_fail: Squat deeper — aim for thighs parallel to the floor
Keep chest up and back straight — do not round your spine
rules.feedback_ok: Back is in a neutral position

rules.feedback_fail: Track your knees over your toes — do not let them cave inward
